HazirMinds — concise summary

HazirMinds is a governed, done-for-you AI firm for small and mid-sized businesses in the United States. Its AI teams answer every inbound call in under one second, 24/7, book appointments into the customer's calendar, write to their CRM, and text confirmations — inside a governance layer: bounded authority ("ability is not authority"), hallucination control with source receipts, and labeled proof horizons on every public claim. Deployment is done-for-you and typically live in 7–14 days. All services run on the HazirMinds Operating Substrate — isolated client environments, dedicated numbers, go-live acceptance criteria.

Pricing (USD)

  • Chronos — $497/mo — AI voice receptionist (300 min), missed-call text-back.
  • Hazir Pro — $997/mo — flagship; adds chat agent, appointment setter, speed-to-lead, review AI, CRM management (800 min).
  • Aeon — $1997/mo — adds AI SDR, outbound, database reactivation, custom AI employee, analytics (2,000 min).
  • Archon — custom — enterprise governance and Chief-of-Staff programs, scoped per engagement.
  • Annual = 2 months free. No unpublished meters — full rate card before go-live. À-la-carte: Governance Readiness Audit $1,500; custom agents from $2,500; Chief-of-Staff engagement from $7,500; extra minutes $0.35/min.

How outcomes are proven

Every deployment is measured against acceptance criteria the client signs before go-live, and reported in writing. Plans are month-to-month after the first 60 days. The full usage rate card is published before go-live — no unpublished meters.
